# BMEC

> BMEC is a statically typed language and compiler for full-stack applications.

Package: 0.9.1-beta.3
Language: 0.1

Start here:
- /ai/
- /ai/index.json
- /ai/knowledge-index.json
- /ai/ai-spec.json
- /ai/commands.json
- /ai/capabilities.json
- /ai/diagnostics.json
- /ai/examples.json
- /playground/
- /docs/PLAYGROUND_GUIDE.md
- /docs/HOW_BMEC_WORKS.md
- /docs/BMEC_EDITOR_SETUP.md
- /docs/AI_AGENT_GUIDE.md
- /docs/CAPABILITY_COVERAGE.md
- /docs/GETTING_STARTED.md
- /docs/CAPABILITIES.md
- /version.json

For task-specific machine-readable context, use `bmec knowledge "TASK" --json`.
Use `bmec check FILE --json` to validate BMEC source and inspect stable diagnostics.
The browser playground checks BMEC locally and can run only bounded pure functions.
The VS Code extension connects to the locally installed BMEC CLI and language server.
